citations.quote: When valuing assets and firms, we need to use discount rates that reflect the riskiness of the cash flows.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Intrinsic valuation derives the value of an equity from the expected cash flows it generates, discounted at a rate that reflects their riskiness. Damodaran frames discounted cash flow valuation as the foundational approach for estimating the value of any asset.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Intrinsic Valuation and Discounted Cash Flows
